description: This file defines the ClientInterface interface in the GuzzleHttp namespace. It specifies methods for sending HTTP requests synchronously and asynchronously, creating requests, and retrieving configuration options, along with associated constants and imports of other interfaces.

classes.name: ClientInterface
classes.description: Interface for a Guzzle HTTP client, defining methods for sending requests synchronously and asynchronously, creating requests, and retrieving configuration settings.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Send an HTTP request synchronously, returning a ResponseInterface.

methods.name: sendAsync
methods.description: Send an HTTP request asynchronously, returning a PromiseInterface.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Create and send an HTTP request, returning a ResponseInterface.

methods.name: requestAsync
methods.description: Create and send an HTTP request asynchronously, returning a PromiseInterface.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieve a client configuration option; deprecated in future versions.
